notes.title: Toon Announcement
notes.content:
Welcome Back!
To Chapter 2!
Hello everyone welcome to Chapter 2, we were supposed to do a video introduction but we have been working hard. We also have been asking around, "What would you feel about a different art style than a realistic one?", Most of the answers we got were yes, we are going to be adding this new style for free. Everyone will have access to this! We will love for different types of player's can be combined in one game!

We are going to be adding an additional 5 new maps. More to come as well. 

Toon Maps!

Toon_Village
Toon_Shrine
Toon_Forest
Toon_Woodland
Toon_OpenWorld

Toon will be also getting more maps after launch. We are also adding more maps in the future free of charge. So this is big news. I will give you guys our first sneak peek view of our Toon worlds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41973783/bab06b94f8f00e77255904b68712df23597ed7a8.png


Toon_Shrine is a majestic Shrine for users to go and pray. But you might want to add some enemies to your world. Things might get a little weird.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41973783/8f71c03507e7a84730aac84fe3f2d11c85a29308.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41973783/ed5384a256f1e45998e6821c7f1b72aed560ee73.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41973783/d364182356ddbfe46caa67e74c621dd1532a9c05.png


Mini-Map
We have added a mini-map, so you guys can see where you guys are going throughout the world. It has a function zoom in and zooms out function. So we are excited for users to fully see themselves and where others are.

Server-Side Functions
So we have added a bunch of server-side functions! We have added Level Traveling to Server-Side so everyone gets transported over to the level you want to play. We also have added Server Time of Day and Weather. So these are important things and by the time Chapter 3 is uploaded, we will have the build menu fully working on the server-side. 

New Map!

We have also have added a small little boss map area called Pre_Destroyed. You can decide how our campaign should run so you can edit the way you want. You can do anything with this visualizer. Pre_Destroyed will be at launch with all other maps to enjoy with your friends.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41973783/9c779cfd596638a97a06dbe79b8b4e6a19bf78fa.png 

Website Lauched!
We have launched our first edition to our website, so anyone can go and see what this is about. Right now our rules section is a little buggy and not really working well with Phones. But looks great on PC. We are working on in-house rules that will be able to be shown on the website. Right now it's linked to DND Beyond's website. Soon it will be shown on our own website with official Dungeon and Dragon's 5E Rules, so you don't have to be linked to another beautiful website such as DND Beyond!

Project D20 Website

As always this is Alex, the Lead Developer at Project D20. We will see you next time. Don't forget to wishlist! See you in Chapter III.....


Join our Discord!:

notes.title: Welcome to Project D20!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, this is our first update to all of our users. Our second chapter will be meeting me and my co-lead developer here at Project D20. We are going to answer some popular questions from some of you that have emailed us!


Chapter 1
We have some interesting news!
Every week we will have a new chapter going up to our official release this is what we have done for the past week! This week was a little challenging fixing up some bug issues and some optimization issues, we did our first test on how many frames, a person would get on an RTX 3080 and I7-10700K. 
The AVG.FPS with dynamic weather was 260fps. Next week we will be testing a 1060 3Gb and an I7-7700. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41973783/d8c6f75ccfddc4ab205b1dee417962d192479ec4.png
 Build Menu Spawns!
 Heiksland is done.
 Notes Page!
 Dice Spawner and Dice Counter
 Steam Integration


Development is steady and we are getting stuff done every day. By next week we should have a preview of our first gameplay test with multiplayer. Of course, there will be some issues but we have some time to polish some stuff. As well as next week to get our first introduction of me and my co-lead. We are going to explain what we are doing and why we are doing it. We want to revolutionize table-top campaigns as a whole. We truly believe this is the next step in doing that. 

1000's Years Before
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41973783/fa7e2a869d0d71fe9ca1721f7844777903136fd6.png
The 1000's Year Before Campaign is an original campaign, a regular user will have to follow the book format, this campaign is only available through Project D20. As the screenshot shows you are in the little village, called Heiksland. This little town will house a future warrior in the future named Eddard that will come 1000's Years later. This part of the story is important you have to succeed or the future will become nothing. You will be joined by different allies through this quest. One of them is Ryujin, the son of Izanagi or the god of lightning, he will be helping you, on finding a way to stop the Dragonian Empire. Even if he has gotten older through his time. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41973783/735823f8030c5d4bf2103c8a88142882ef59336f.png

This is it for our news and we will see you back next Sunday! For Chapter II.
As always this is Alex, the Lead Developer at Project D20. We will see you next time. Don't forget to wishlist! 

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/FK57FFAvSV
